titles.title: My Backyard

description: Green bushes populate a flat stretch of earth running beneath tall red hills. Rising above the hills are smooth, yellow and white cliffs with wide geologic strata in different shades. Small green bushes also appear at the very top of the cliff, just below a tiny sliver of blue sky.
title: My Backyard
